RATIONALE:
Q1: Option A cannot work in this pipeline. The heal implementer only keeps edits to paths listed in the unedited scope marker the intake wrote (`.github/workflows/internal-review.yml`, `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, `tests/**`, `changelog.d/*.md`). That marker is checked in `scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh`, and an answer here cannot widen it. An edit to `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` would fail in `scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh` with `reason=out_of_heal_scope`, and `implement_heal_preflight.sh refuse out_of_heal_scope` would then add `ai:needs-human`. Option B stays inside the verified scope and still yields a mergeable PR. Option C leaves the heal issue with nothing to merge. The refusal is also the designed outcome: agents.md says host-only conflicted paths "need a manual merge", and the non-retryable cap tripped on the first marker as intended.
Q2: Only applies when Q1 = A, so there is nothing to decide in this issue. One correction for any future, separately scoped issue: `gh_api_write_guard.py` is not host-only. `scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py::allowed` (lines 123-124) already lets it into the sandbox. The host-only hooks are `pr_merge_status_guard.py` (lines 120-122), and `pr_watch_guard.py` and `session-start.sh`, which the leading-dot rule at line 128 excludes.
Q3: Only applies when Q1 = A; there is nothing to decide in this issue.

    - Add one regression case in `tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_sandbox_only.py` (reuse the `_run_path_guard` helper) for a gap the existing tests leave open. Build a real scratch git repo where `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` is changed on both sides so `git merge` leaves index stages 1/2/3. Feed `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` into the guard. Set only `cwd` and scrub the GIT_* variables as the conftest does.
    - Add an assertion, or a small test if none exists, that `conflict_resolver_sandbox_path_host_only` is in `workflow_failure_heal.NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS`. That keeps one occurrence tripping the cap at once rather than the PR #6438 re-run loop.
    - Run the new tests and record the results in the PR.
    - The changelog fragment and PR body must say:
      - the refusal is by design;
      - PR #6555's hook conflict needs a human merge;
      - deterministic template-twin resolution is out of this issue's verified heal scope;
      - if wanted, it needs its own issue granting `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`.
    - Link this issue and PR #6555 with `Refs #<n>`, not an auto-close keyword, against #6555.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: "regression test that fails on the reported head and passes with the fix"
  equivalence_argument: Head bd3002618928 behaved as designed (fail-closed, non-retryable, heal reported). No in-scope code change can "remove the cause", because the cause is a real conflict on a host-executed safety hook that policy requires a human to merge. A test that reproduces the exact git-level failure condition and pins the fail-closed contract guards against the real regression risk: the guard or cap being weakened. It does not invent behaviour outside the verified scope.
  reversibility: Test-only and changelog-only change. A later, properly scoped issue can add twin resolution and update or extend these tests.
